content.text: No minimum commitment exists, and the Customer has a robust exit. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: Section 2.1 expressly disclaims any minimum quantity or purchase commitment and confirms Customer pays only for Services actually ordered, with no shortfall exposure for declining to place further orders. Section 7.1 bars any undisclosed minimum-use charge, and Section 12.3 records that Customer has made no exclusivity or minimum-volume commitment. No take-or-pay, shortfall penalty, or volume cap on Customer usage appears in Fees (§7), Order Forms (§4), or Term (§8). Customer also retains termination for convenience under Section 9.4 with a refund of prepaid Fees, so even ordered volumes are exitable. This meets and exceeds our preferred position, so no redline is needed. (Section 7.7's late-payment liquidated damages is a payment-default issue outside this rule.)
